kibana.query:
TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_hwmon_temp_celsius IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_hwmon_temp_crit_celsius IS NOT NULL
| STATS temp = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_hwmon_temp_celsius)), Critical = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_hwmon_temp_crit_celsius)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.chip_name, labels.sensor
| EVAL legend = CONCAT(COALESCE(TO_STRING(`labels.chip_name`), ""), " ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(`labels.sensor`), ""), " temp")
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_cooling_device_cur_state IS NOT NULL OR metrics.node_cooling_device_max_state IS NOT NULL
| STATS Current_in = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_cooling_device_cur_state)), Max_in = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_cooling_device_max_state)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.name, labels.type
| EVAL legend = CONCAT("Current ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(`labels.name`), ""), " in ", COALESCE(TO_STRING(`labels.type`), ""))
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_power_supply_online IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_power_supply_online = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(metrics.node_power_supply_online)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.power_supply
| SORT time_bucket ASC
